Tábor

Sunday 29 November 2026

On Sunday 29 November, the cyclo-cross peloton heads to Tábor in the Czech Republic for the second round of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup. Last year, teammates Lucinda Brand and Thibau Nys claimed victory there. Who will follow in their footsteps?

Tickets

Would you like to be there in Tábor on Sunday 29 November? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

Online:

Until 28 November inclusive: 390 CZK

29 November: 450 CZK

At the on-site box office: 450 CZK

People over 65 and people with disabilities: CZK 200 (only at the on-site box office on race day)

Children up to 130 cm enjoy free admission and do not need to book a ticket.

[TO THE TICKET SHOP](https://www.cyklokros.cz/vstupenky-sp2026#/)
